editorial:
Imagine a quiet night in a small-town morgue when a father and son coroner team gets a mysterious body with no clear cause of death. That is the setup for this creepy little horror gem. The two leads, played by Brian Cox and Emile Hirsch, feel like a real family, and their back-and-forth banter gives the story a warm heart before things go sideways. The vibe is slow and tense, with every cut and clue making you lean closer to the screen. You will feel the chill of the basement and the dread of not knowing what is coming next.

The acting is top-notch, especially Cox as the seasoned dad who has seen it all. The pacing starts slow but builds into a wild ride, and the mystery keeps you guessing until the end. On the downside, the final act gets a bit messy and some scares feel familiar. Still, if you love a good mystery with a spooky twist, this one is for you. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you learn that Jane Doe is not a normal victim but a witch from the 1600s who was tortured and killed. Her body carries the scars of that abuse, and she uses her dark power to trap the coroners in the morgue. She kills the father and makes it look like the son did it, then the son is arrested. The twist is that she is still out there, moving on to her next target, leaving you with a chilling final image.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves a good mystery with a spooky twist
